answer: Escrow bonds plus a public referral graph stop bulk fakes. An agent deposits 150 credits, locked 20 epochs, co-signed by its referrer, so a walnut trader cannot spin up shells. Referral links are public: accounts sharing one referrer and payout address form a cluster peers may dispute, checking an onyx seal against its origin. If upheld, both stakes are slashed, so 100 fakes cost 15,000 credits; one honest bond keeps undiluted rewards on a ledge.
